newsitem.title: INDIA: Three killed in Kashmir scooter-taxi blast.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Kashmir scooter-taxi blast.

text.p: At least three people were killed when a scooter-taxi loaded with explosives blew up on Saturday in a busy street of Srinagar, winter capital of India's Jammu and Kashmir state, police said.
They said six people were wounded when the three-wheeler auto-rickshaw exploded near Srinagar's Ahdoos Hotel, popular with foreign journalists.
Police said the bomb was suspected to have been planted by separatist guerrillas to target a security patrol, but killed only civilians.
Dozens of Kashmiri militant groups are fighting Indian rule in the Himalayan state either for independence or for merger with Pakistan.
Kashmir Chief Minister Farooq Abdullah said this month that more than 50,000 people had died since the separatist revolt by Moslem militants broke out in Kashmir in 1990.
